newsitem.title: USA: Jacor Communications says selling stations.
newsitem.headline: Jacor Communications says selling stations.

text.p: Jacor Communications Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to sell four of its radio stations to JS Communications Inc for $23 million.
The company said it is selling WXLY-FM and WEZL-FM of Charleston, S.C., KCBQ-AM of San Diego and WXZZ-FM of Lexington, Ky.
The company said the transcations are subject to regulatory review.
The company said it plans to continue acquiring complementary stations in its existing broadcast locations, and radio groups or stations with a significant presence in other locations.
The company said it may also buy other broadcast-related businesses.
